summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing the release of its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results on May 12, 2026, and an accompanying conference call. It is a routine earnings release notice with no mention of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing serves only to update the market on scheduled earnings disclosure and contains no event that constitutes a special situation.
